name: California
agency: California State Parks, Division of Boating and Waterways

rule.phaseIn: Phased in by age from 2018; since Jan. 1, 2025 it covers all ages.
rule.textEn: Since Jan. 1, 2025 every operator of a motorized recreational vessel, whatever the age, must carry a California Boater Card.
rule.textEs: Desde el 1 de enero de 2025 todo operador de una embarcación recreativa con motor, de cualquier edad, debe llevar la California Boater Card.

minAge.note: Under 16 may not run a motor over 15 hp (sailboats up to 30 ft excepted); ages 12-15 may with an adult 18+ on board.

exemptions: Under the direct supervision of an adult 18+ who holds a card.
Out-of-state visitor boating fewer than 60 days who meets home-state rules (90 days for a foreign visitor).
Holders of a current commercial fishing license or a US Coast Guard marine operator license.

card.feeNote: Lifetime card issued by the Division of Boating and Waterways; courses are separate (free and paid courses exist).

nonResident: A visitor boating in California for fewer than 60 days who meets the home-state requirement does not need the card (90 days for foreign visitors).
rental: Renters are exempt from the card.

sources.publisher: California State Parks, Division of Boating and Waterways
sources.quote: The lifetime card fee will be $10. The lost card replacement fee will be $5.
